fusions.name: Split Shard
fusions.desc: Hurls a two-pronged shard that deals 14 damage to the first enemy it meets and stuns it for 1 second, then forks to 1 more enemy within 3.5 tiles for 80% of the damage.

fusions.name: Crossing Cracks
fusions.desc: Cracks the ground in two crossing lines around you, dealing 26 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles. Every hit is a critical hit.

fusions.name: Parting Wall
fusions.desc: Raises a wall of stone 4 tiles long ahead of you for 8 seconds. Nothing crosses it.

fusions.name: Tines Converge
fusions.desc: Every hit you land builds a stack on that enemy, up to 4. When you reach 4, they all spend at once: a blow strikes it for 20% of your weapon damage per stack (82% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.
